name: railway
description: A Pulumi native provider for managing Railway infrastructure.

nodejs.packageDescription: Native Pulumi provider for Railway: projects, services, variables, custom domains, and volumes

token.description: Railway account or workspace API token.

provider.description: Configuration for authenticating with the Railway API.

token.description: Railway account or workspace API token.
Railway account or workspace API token.

railway:index:Bucket.description: An S3-compatible Railway object storage bucket deployed to one environment.

accessKeyId.description: S3 access key ID for the bucket's environment instance.

endpoint.description: S3 API endpoint, for example https://storage.railway.app.

environmentId.description: ID of the environment the bucket is deployed to.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the bucket.

s3BucketName.description: Globally unique bucket name for the S3 API (display name plus hash).

s3Region.description: Region value S3 clients should use, for example auto.

secretAccessKey.description: S3 secret access key for the bucket's environment instance.

urlStyle.description: URL style S3 clients should use: virtual or path.

environmentId.description: ID of the environment the bucket is deployed to.

name.description: Display name for the bucket. Railway generates a name when omitted.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the bucket.

region.description: Bucket region: sjc (US West), iad (US East), ams (EU West), or sin (Asia Pacific). It cannot change after creation.

railway:index:CustomDomain.description: A custom domain attached to a Railway service instance.

cnameTarget.description: DNS CNAME value required by Railway.

environmentId.description: ID of the Railway environment where the domain is attached.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the domain.

serviceId.description: ID of the Railway service where the domain is attached.

targetPort.description: Optional container port to which Railway routes domain traffic.

verificationToken.description: Token used to verify domain ownership.

domain.description: Hostname without a scheme, path, or port, for example api.example.com.

environmentId.description: ID of the Railway environment where the domain is attached.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the domain.

serviceId.description: ID of the Railway service where the domain is attached.

targetPort.description: Optional container port to which Railway routes domain traffic.

railway:index:Environment.description: A Railway environment inside a project.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the environment.

name.description: Environment name. It must be unique within the project.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the environment.

railway:index:Project.description: A Railway project, the top-level container for services and environments.

defaultEnvironmentId.description: ID of the project's primary environment, typically production.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that contains the project.
Workspace ID in which to create the project. Projects without one are temporary and expire after 24 hours unless claimed.

railway:index:Service.description: A Railway service and its configuration in one environment.

branch.description: GitHub branch deployed by the service.

buildCommand.description: Command Railway runs to build the service.

healthcheckPath.description: HTTP path Railway uses for health checks.

instanceId.description: Railway service instance ID for the configured environment.

numReplicas.description: Number of service replicas. Zero means scaled to zero.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the service.

region.description: Railway region for the service instance.

rootDirectory.description: Root directory used as the build context.

startCommand.description: Command Railway runs to start the service.

autoUpdateType.description: Automatic image update policy: disabled, patch, or minor. Requires an image source from Docker Hub or GHCR.

branch.description: GitHub branch to deploy. Valid only when repo is set.

buildCommand.description: Command Railway runs to build the service.

environmentId.description: ID of the environment whose service instance is configured.

healthcheckPath.description: HTTP path Railway uses for health checks.

healthcheckTimeout.description: Health check timeout in seconds. Railway defaults to 300.

image.description: Docker image source, for example redis:7-alpine. Mutually exclusive with repo. Changing the image updates the service in place.

numReplicas.description: Number of service replicas. Zero sends zero replicas to Railway; combining with Railway's serverless (App Sleep) feature is required to stop incurring usage while idle.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the service.

region.description: Railway region for the service instance.

repo.description: GitHub repository source in owner/repository form. Mutually exclusive with image.

rootDirectory.description: Root directory used as the build context.

startCommand.description: Command Railway runs to start the service.

railway:index:Variable.description: A service-scoped or environment-shared Railway variable.

environmentId.description: ID of the Railway environment that owns the variable.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the variable.

serviceId.description: Optional service ID, unset for an environment-shared variable.

environmentId.description: ID of the Railway environment that owns the variable.

key.description: Variable name. It must be a valid environment variable identifier.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the variable.

serviceId.description: Optional service ID. Omit it for an environment-shared variable.

railway:index:Volume.description: A persistent Railway volume attached to a service instance.

environmentId.description: ID of the Railway environment where the volume is attached.

mountPath.description: Absolute mount path inside the service container.

name.description: Optional display name for the volume.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the volume.

serviceId.description: ID of the Railway service where the volume is attached.

environmentId.description: ID of the Railway environment where the volume is attached.

mountPath.description: Absolute normalized mount path inside the service container.

name.description: Optional display name for the volume.

projectId.description: ID of the Railway project that owns the volume.

serviceId.description: ID of the Railway service where the volume is attached.
